R1.description: The committed timings are measured on CI and cover the inventory, and a ratchet fails when the untimed share grows past its limit

R2.description: The acceptance-matrix contention is measured at the shard on the CI runs and the result is recorded; the planner stays unchanged unless a factor qualifies (none does)

R3.description: The guides, the item pages and the backlog state the result, the measured effect and the split into ci2b to ci2e
